formalization: ChatGPT; candidate interpretation of the supplied route, not a claim of the user's intended identification
question: Can an explicit frame turn empty evidence into its full admissible model family, support checked symmetry-breaking selection, derive a complete three-way question partition under consistency, and preserve that partition through finite observation and conservative frame extension?
level: External finite set/Boolean model and ordinary mathematical proofs; no native Adva semantics, physical symmetry breaking, or endogenous vocabulary discovery
imports: Boolean interpretations of named atomic questions
A supplied alternating answer fixture for the continuation demonstration

interface.frame: Finite question set U, nonempty admissible model family W, explicit ordered coordinate frame, fixed checker, history and shared fuel
interface.empty: No additional evidence, interpreted relative to the declared model family; never an untyped empty universe
interface.triad: Questions true in every remaining model, false in every remaining model, or admitting both answers
interface.extension: Append a fresh Boolean question and both possible interpretations; restriction onto the old model family is surjective
interface.drop: Commit only a checked answer and retain the full event and evidence archive

families.model_families: Every subset of the 2^n Boolean interpretations, including empty families as inconsistency controls
families.updates: Every question and each answer in each nonempty family
families.permutations: All permutations of each question set, including their action on models and explicit selection frames
families.extensions: Every nonempty family at n<=3 extended to n+1 with both fresh bit values
families.fixed_selector_controls: All three constant selections on a fully symmetric three-question state fail cyclic equivariance

checker: Producer uses integer bit operations; independent checker expands complete Boolean tuples and counts each answer, reconstructs image/restriction and replays the frozen trace using integer division and addition. Shared Python and declared scope remain trusted; no formal proof assistant is invoked.
protected: Unknown epistemic status is not a third Boolean truth value
Selection frame is explicit symmetry-breaking data
All old question judgments survive conservative extension
Rejected models, active checks and spent fuel remain recorded
Candidate data cannot replace the checker
Resource exhaustion never becomes a negative theorem
Three-way status partition does not identify the native three machines or prove exactly three metaphysical domains
No fixed total budget is claimed to fund infinitely many steps
exit: One frozen run stops at PassedFiniteCalibration, ImplementationFailure, or Unknown on a resource limit. Retain every completed family and failure; no automatic rerun or native promotion.
cost_scope: One model unit per extend/select/check/drop action. Logical units count explicitly charged comparisons, rows, and serialization chunks; CPU and wall limits include process execution and checkpointing. Research, authoring and remote publication are outside the execution budget. Hard termination can prevent the final artifact.
open: Whether this question-status trichotomy is the user's intended one-into-three mechanism
A checked relation to native three-computation and thread duality
Actual external evidence and useful new questions beyond the supplied Boolean schema
A certified frame extension over existing Rust-owned artifacts
